svg.title: I brought the visitor here
svg.desc: A frontal limestone head of a monk, photographed against gray. A rust-colored dotted arrow approaches from an empty circle at the right and stops between the eyes. The arrow is the artist's approach, not the sculpture's gaze.
svg.text: The face turns forward; the eyes seem to fall below mine.
I cannot place where it lands.
I carry the visitor from the landscape toward this face.
The arrow is mine. The stone does not tell me if it noticed.
Head of a Monk, China, Tang dynasty (618–907), 7th century. Limestone. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, object 42.25.10.
Public-domain collection image. The approach line and marks are mine.
